svg.aria-label: The DGX-1 V100 hybrid cube-mesh. Eight V100s sit in two quads of four, and each GPU has 6 NVLinks, about 50 GB/s each. Inside a quad every pair is linked, some with 2 links and some with 1, and each GPU also links to its twin in the other quad, so GPU0 and GPU7 share no link at all. Between a pair NCCL uses P2P over NVLink if a link exists, else shared memory staged through the host, else the NIC, InfiniBand or sockets, and InfiniBand is off here. NVSwitch makes every pair one hop.
svg.text: GPU0 and GPU7 share no link
over NVLink, if a link exists
IB or sockets, IB off here
